cohort: 250 mothers attending six Primary Health Care centers for infant immunization at six weeks post-delivery in Eti-Osa Local Government Area of Lagos State, Nigeria
finding: The prevalence of postpartum depression was 35.6%, with multiparity, cesarean delivery, mother being unwell after delivery, and not exclusively breastfeeding linked to postpartum depression, while postpartum blues, lack of help with infant care, intimate partner violence, and unsupportive partners were identified as predictors.
mod_finding: Cesarean delivery was linked to postpartum depression.
